notes.title: The Adventure of Dai pre-launch report from TGS & news regarding game function.
notes.content:
As we get ready for the imminent release of Infinity Strash: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai, we would like to bring you a special report from the Tokyo Game Show, held from the 21st to the 24th of September, and also make an announcement regarding specific game functionality when playing on PC.

A huge number of visitors flocked to the Tokyo Game Show 2023! The Square Enix booth had life-sized panels of Dai and the characters from the game and also ran a cosplay photography area! The game itself was available to play on numerous demo stations, with loads of visitors coming along to try it out.
On top of that, we also held a stage event for Infinity Strash on the 24th of September, where further details of Challenge Mode were revealed as well as a first look at Vearn the Dark King and the Extreme Annihilation Spell Medroa!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44165942/fb0f5fd4e10284fc9851d85da888078826770440.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44165942/5762e217e0000fd024dc93999d377595e3e31095.jpg[/img]

With Infinity Strash: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai available very soon, we would also like to communicate how specific features of the PC version function on certain hardware.

In a limited number of user environments, some customers may experience an issue where the game screen will briefly stutter (a temporary drop in the frame-rate) when using spells or abilities during play for the first time.

This issue occurs due to the special effects for spells or abilities that have not yet been used taking a moment to load during a quest. However, you can be reassured that after such a spell or ability has been used once, it will create a cache and any previously experienced frame drops will become much less likely from then on.

Infinity Strash: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai is just around the corner, and we invite everyone to join Dai and friends on their big adventure!

In addition, Infinity Strash DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai has also received Steam Deck Verification. This means that the game can be played smoothly and stress-free on the Steam Deck hardware.

The producer has also published a message to accompany the reveal of the minimum and recommended specifications.

ーーーーーーーー
Infinity Strash DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai producer Takumi Kasai here.
We have just released the required specifications for the PC version of the game.
We definitely wanted this game to be played by existing DRAGON QUEST series and Adventure of Dai fans, but also by many other gamers out there who may never have tried a DRAGON QUEST game before. This desire led us to develop the game so that as many people from as many countries and with as broad a range of hardware setups as possible will be able to play and enjoy it.

As a fan of the animated series myself, I applied all the ingenuity I could muster to making sure the game allowed players to follow and experience the wonderful story of Dai, the numerous friends and foes he meets along the way and how he grows as a person, in the best way possible. I very much look forward to seeing how all the players enjoy the many famous battles and story scenes we have lovingly re-created.

In addition to being able to re-live the story from The Adventure of Dai, the game also includes another mode called the Temple of Recollection that has rogue-like elements. This mode was mainly intended as a way to train up so you could overcome setbacks in the main story, but also offers a wealth of exciting content and challenges for an outstanding standalone gameplay experience. I would be delighted to see gamers who aren’t familiar with the original comic or animated series but who are fans of the rogue-like (light) genre giving Infinity Strash a go. I think you will have a lot of fun!

That covers the overall content of the game, but as I mentioned at the top, we have made the PC edition to allow as many people with as many PC setups as possible to play it. It depends on the specific specifications, but we have strived to make the game smooth and comfortable to play. I am confident that Infinity Strash is a title that will be enjoyed by PC gamers who have heard of DRAGON QUEST and The Adventure of Dai before, as well as those who are seeing it for the first time, so I invite you to try it out, whoever you are!

We are working hard on various preparations for the launch of the game, so please hold on just a little longer for it and watch out for further information!

Infinity Strash DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai
Producer Takumi Kasai
